error.title: Kitsu project not linked
error.description:
## AYON project is not linked to Kitsu
Project **{project_name}** has no valid Kitsu project id, or that project no longer exists on the Kitsu server.
### What to do
Ask production support to verify the AYON project Kitsu link and that the Kitsu project still exists.

error.title: Folder not linked to Kitsu
error.description:
## **{folder_name}** is not linked to Kitsu
AYON folder **{folder_path}** has no `kitsuId`. This publish is configured to push to Kitsu and needs a shot or asset link.
### What to do
Re-sync the folder from Kitsu in AYON, or pick a folder that is already linked.

error.title: Folder exists only in AYON
error.description:
## **{folder_name}** is on AYON but not on Kitsu
The publish folder **{folder_path}** is in AYON, but Kitsu has no matching shot or asset (stored link `{kitsu_id}` is missing or stale).
Task linkage cannot work until the **folder** exists on Kitsu and AYON is re-synced.
### What to do
Create or restore the shot or asset in Kitsu, then re-sync this folder in AYON before publishing again.
error.detail: Technical: `gazu.entity.get_entity` returned no row for id `{kitsu_id}`.

error.title: Task missing on Kitsu shot or asset
error.description:
## Task **{task_name}** is not on Kitsu for **{folder_name}**
The folder **{folder_path}** is linked on Kitsu, but there is no matching Kitsu task for this publish (AYON task id: `{ayon_task_id}`).
### What to do
Add the task type on Kitsu for this shot or asset, or re-sync tasks in AYON and pick the correct task.

error.title: Kitsu task data incomplete
error.description:
## Kitsu task is missing status information
A Kitsu task was found (id `{kitsu_task_id}`) but the API response did not include `task_status`, which is required for notes and status updates.
### What to do
Retry the publish. If it persists, report to production support with the Kitsu task id above.
